visual_elements.description: Conceptual gradient descent plot. Y-axis is Cost with an upward arrow. X-axis is θ with a rightward arrow. A black U-shaped parabola is drawn. A series of approximately 8 purple/blue dots descends along the left side of the curve from a high cost toward the minimum, with step sizes decreasing near the bottom. A single yellow dot marks the minimum. A dashed vertical line drops from the first dot to the x-axis. Text 'Random initial value' sits below the dashed line. Text 'Learning step' sits to the right of the dot sequence with a small arrow pointing to the dots. Text 'Minimum' sits to the right of the yellow dot. A '+' sign is marked on the x-axis to the right of the dashed line. The symbol θ̂ is printed below the x-axis beneath the minimum point.
visual_elements.position: center of slide inside red-bordered box

typography_notes: Title is large, bold, dark red, likely a serif or heavy sans-serif, possibly with slight letter spacing. Graph labels are smaller, black, sans-serif. Axis labels use Greek symbols. The slide number is small black text inside a yellow circle.

recreation_brief:
1. Set slide background to light gray (#F0F0F0).
2. Add title text at top center in dark red (#8B0000), bold, approximately 32–36pt: 'Follow Negative Direction of Gradient with Selected Learning Rate'.
3. Add a small yellow circle (#FFFF00) at the top right corner containing the black text '27'.
4. Draw a rectangular shape in the center with a thin red border (#FF0000) and no fill to frame the graph.
5. Inside the box, draw a vertical Y-axis line on the left with an arrowhead pointing up; place the label 'Cost' above it.
6. Draw a horizontal X-axis line at the bottom with an arrowhead pointing right; place the label 'θ' at the right end.
7. Draw a black U-shaped parabola opening upward, with its minimum near the horizontal center of the box.
8. Place a sequence of about 8 purple/blue dots (#0000CD) along the left side of the curve, starting high on the left and stepping down toward the minimum; make the vertical spacing between dots shrink as they approach the minimum.
9. Place one yellow dot (#FFFF00) exactly at the curve minimum.
10. Draw a dashed vertical line from the first (top-left) dot down to the X-axis.
11. Add the text 'Random initial value' below the dashed line at the lower left.
12. Add the text 'Learning step' to the right of the dot sequence with a small arrow pointing left toward the dots.
13. Add the text 'Minimum' to the right of the yellow dot.
14. Add a '+' symbol on the X-axis to the right of the dashed line.
15. Add the symbol 'θ̂' below the X-axis directly under the minimum point.
